meta.description: ChaSet unified design tokens. Three tiers: primitives (scales), semantic (aliased roles, per-product presets), composite (multi-part surfaces, platform-gated). Two product presets: 'launcher' (crd-a launcher, shadcn/Tailwind v4, oklch) and 'dunting' (dt-a Qt/QML ThemeManager palette). Values are transcribed verbatim from product sources; nothing is invented or normalized.

excluded.accentHover/accentPressed: runtime-derived in theme_manager.cpp (accent().lighter(112)/darker(110)); never static tokens
excluded.tabMinWidth/tabMaxWidth: user preferences, not design tokens (theme_manager_test.cpp owns them)

sources.launcher.accent-themes: dist/consumers/launcher/generated/tokens.generated.css (10 palette ids: neutral, custom, slate, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet, rose)
sources.launcher.window-tints: dist/consumers/launcher/generated/tokens.generated.css (12 selector blocks: 6 light, 6 dark; tint ids slate/graphite/mist/sage/plum/custom)

mappings.dunting-to-core.border: border (+input, inherited - dunting defines no separate input token)

reclassifications: app-status-success/warning/error stay in composite.launcher under their original --app-* names (consumers reference them by those names; tiering follows source fidelity)
--hover (shadcn-base.css) merged with dunting hover into semantic.interaction.hover (same role)

conventions.colors.dunting: #RRGGBBAA hex rendered from QColor::fromRgbF(r,g,b,a) via channel*255 rounded half-away-from-zero once (Qt 8-bit quantization); opaque colors carry 'ff'. Conversion table: .omo/evidence/t1/conversion-table.md
conventions.colors.launcher: verbatim oklch()/color-mix()/var() strings from css sources
conventions.composite.shape: { "$platform": ["css"], "light"?: string, "dark"?: string }; a part present in one mode only appears in that mode only
conventions.inheritance: preset values absent from a source are inherited from the token's base and flagged "inherited": true
conventions.keys: custom property names stored WITHOUT leading '--'; generators re-add it
conventions.overrides.shape: { selector (verbatim from source css), preset, axes..., tokens: { name: value } }
